acceptance: The aipo-js emitter produces an ESM bundle with a versioned runtime shim, embedded Core IR and a valid ECMA-426 source map.

The stable aipo build command reuses the frontend pipeline, emits nothing for check-time diagnostics and reports runtime faults through Node with the same observable codes and exit behavior as the VM.
The frozen Wave 1 corpus programs 01-20 has exact VM, JavaScript and committed stdout parity, including the documented module cases.
The evidence record publishes the implementation decisions, gate results and known limitations without changing canonical language semantics.
cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, cargo doc --workspace --no-deps, prumo validate and prumo doctor are green.
